- What’s the downgrade/rollback path if we need to revert feature flags or reduce seats after the pilot? Any proration policy?
- Do you offer a pilot discount or onboarding credit that can be applied against the first invoice?
- For procurement we need to understand any SLA credit language and whether dedicated capacity is required for the 500-seat target.

I attached a rough SOW (attached) and an internal timeline. Can you send a short commercial sketch and recommended entitlements mapping?

Appreciate it —
Olivia

Hi Olivia —

Great to hear the pilot is moving forward. High level answers below; I’ll follow up with a compact pricing sketch and an MPP (mutual action plan) draft by end of day.

- Pilot -> Prod path: we recommend a modular entitlements approach: start with a "Core claims triage" module + "Audit/Export" add-on. Pilot seats billed as "pilot tier" (50 seats) that map 1:1 to PROD entitlements so there’s no rework on provisioning. Once you hit the production threshold we switch to a committed seat block and migrate entitlements automatically.
- Downgrade/rollback: seats may be reduced at monthly boundaries with prorated credits for unused committed months; feature toggles can be remapped to the pilot entitlement group. We’ll include a rollback playbook in the MPP.
- Pilot discount/credit: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $8,000 for the pilot and a 20% pilot discount on seat-list for the first 3 months (applies to the pilot seat block only).
- SLA / capacity: for ~500 seats we recommend Redwood Dedicated in-region for lower p95 latency; SLA credits are standard (up to 10% service credit) — we’ll attach the SLA clause.

Questions for you: what do you anticipate for peak concurrent users and average request length? That will determine the Dedicated sizing.

I’ve CC’d Monica (customer success) for onboarding scope and Aditya for pricing/contract redlines.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference

Internal — forwarding MedSig ask. Key points and recommended commercial levers: 

Context: pilot = 50 seats (8 weeks), prod = 500 seats (staged). They want no rework on entitlement mapping and an explicit downgrade/rollback path.

Suggested structure:
- Pilot: 20% off seat list for 3 months + one-time onboarding credit $8k (apply against first invoice).
- Committed Prod Block: 500 seats -> base discount 25% off list; step discount to 30% available if they commit 12-month prepay or reach 750 seats within 6 months.
- Migration credit: provide a $10k migration credit (applied if they convert to Dedicated capacity within 90 days of pilot end).
- SLA language: standard SLA; accept up to 10% service credit as defined. If they demand higher SLA, position Dedicated + premium support for a fee.
- Downgrade handling: allow monthly seat reduction with proration for committed carriers; limit deep downgrades (>=30% reduction) to once per 90-day window without renegotiation.

Risks / asks:
- Feature gating complexity: if they want per-seat entitlements per region, we’ll need extra provisioning work (estimate 5 engineer-days) — recommend we include an implementation SOW line item or cover via migration credit.
- Pricing_workbook_v6.xlsx attached with model scenarios; the migration credit and onboarding credit are discretionary.

Aditya — any objection on margins if we do 20% pilot + $10k migration credit? Marissa — recommend we attach a short MPP and the rollback playbook before AEs talk to procurement.

Thanks,
Diego

Attachment (internal): pricing_workbook_v6.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Subject: Entitlement & pricing proposal — MedSig pilot -> prod (short sketch)

Olivia —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Below is a compact proposal you can share with procurement; I’ve also added links to the MPP and a short rollback playbook. If this looks good I’ll issue a formal quote and DocuSign package.

1) Pilot (8 weeks) — 50 seats
- Pilot seat list price: $120/seat/mo
- Pilot discount: 20% for first 3 months
- One-time onboarding credit: $8,000 (applied to pilot invoice)
- Attachment: MPP (https://docs.redwood/company/mpp/medsig-pilot)

2) Production staging — 500 seats target
- Committed block: 500 seats at 25% off list; if they prepay 12 months we can increase to 30% off
- Migration credit: $10,000 credit if they convert to Dedicated within 90 days of pilot

3) Downgrade & rollback policy
- Monthly seat reduction allowed at month boundaries with proration; reductions >=30% flagged and limited to once per 90 days without explicit renegotiation
- Feature toggles: entitlements map 1:1 from pilot to prod; we will provide a rollback playbook and runbook as part of onboarding

4) SLA & capacity recommendation
- For 500 seats we recommend Redwood Dedicated (in-region) for p95 latency targets; standard SLA with service credit up to 10% applies. If MedSig requires tighter SLOs, we can add premium support (pricing on request).

Next steps: please confirm peak concurrent estimate (or let us know if you want us to run a quick sizing call). If you agree I’ll send a formal quote with DocuSign and the MPP attached.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot scheduled.
